question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The attainment of powers is named explicitly.
This attainment is identified with the root Kaula.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight accomplishments is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
